What factor of a wetland affects migratory birds? and if the factor changes in the future, how will behaviour change?

```{r load package, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(readr)
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)      # For Shannon Diversity (H')
library(lubridate)
```

wetland_names_en <- c(
  '고창 운곡습지' = 'Gochang Ungok',

```{r}
# Create a Season column based on Month (월)
wq_data <- wq_data %>%
  mutate(Season = case_when(
    월 %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ "Spring",
    월 %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ "Summer",
    월 %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Fall",
    월 %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter"
  ))

# Aggregate to Yearly Means and Seasonal Extremes
wq_aggregated <- wq_data %>%
  mutate(Wetland = dplyr::recode(Wetland, !!!wetland_names_en)) %>%
  group_by(Wetland, 연도) %>%
  summarise(
    # Yearly Means
    Mean_Water_Temp = mean(수온, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_DO   = mean(용존산소.DO., na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_pH   = mean(수소이온농도.pH., na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_DTN  = mean(용존총질소.DTN., na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_BOD  = mean(생물화학적산소요구량.BOD., na.rm = TRUE),
    # Seasonal Extremes
    Summer_Min_DO   = min(용존산소.DO.[Season == "Summer"], na.rm = TRUE),
    Summer_Max_Water_Temp = max(수온[Season == "Summer"], na.rm = TRUE),
    Spring_Mean_DTN = mean(용존총질소.DTN.[Season == "Spring"], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(Year = 연도) %>%
  # Clean up any Inf/-Inf values generated if a season had missing data
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ifelse(is.infinite(.), NA, .)))
wq_aggregated
```

---------------------------------------------------------
Biomonitoring Data (Group-Specific Shannon Indices)
---------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
bio_data <- read.csv("/Users/yjkang/Desktop/NIE_BigData/wetland_birds/data/Wetland_2006_2023/Biomonitor/Combined_Wetland_Biomonitoring_2011_2024.csv", fileEncoding = "UTF-8")

#rename to English using partial matching, then coalesce
bio_data <- bio_data %>%
  mutate(Wetland = dplyr::recode(Wetland, !!!wetland_names_en)) %>%
  rename(
    Count           = contains("개체수"),
    Density_ind_m2 = contains("개체밀도"),
    Density_cells_cm2   = contains("세포수")
  ) %>%
  # We coalesce them so that if '개체수' is NA, it uses the density column.
  mutate(Abundance = coalesce(Count, Density_ind_m2, Density_cells_cm2)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Abundance))

# Custom function to create a community matrix and calculate H'
calculate_shannon_for_group <- function(data, group_name, prefix) {
  # 1. Filter for the specific group
  group_data <- data %>% filter(Bio_Group == group_name)
  # If the group doesn't exist in the data, return NULL
  if(nrow(group_data) == 0) return(NULL)
  # 2. Pivot wider to create a Site x Species matrix (required by vegan)
  comm_matrix <- group_data %>%
    group_by(Wetland, Year, 학명) %>%
    summarise(Total_Abundance = sum(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = 학명, values_from = Total_Abundance, values_fill = 0)
  # 3. Separate metadata (Wetland, Year) from actual species counts
  species_counts <- comm_matrix %>% select(-Wetland, -Year)
  # 4. Calculate Shannon Diversity Index
  shannon_idx <- vegan::diversity(species_counts, index = "shannon")
  # 5. Bind back with Wetland and Year
  result <- comm_matrix %>%
    select(Wetland, Year) %>%
    mutate(!!sym(prefix) := shannon_idx)
  return(result) }

h_diatoms <- calculate_shannon_for_group(bio_data, "Algae/Diatoms", "H_Diatoms")
h_benthic <- calculate_shannon_for_group(bio_data, "Benthic Invertebrates", "H_Benthic")
h_fish    <- calculate_shannon_for_group(bio_data, "Fish", "H_Fish")
print(head(h_diatoms))
print(head(h_benthic))
print(head(h_fish))
```

```{r}
library(janitor)      # For cleaning column names
library(usdm)         # For sequential VIF calculation

df <- read.csv("/Users/yjkang/Desktop/NIE_BigData/wetland_birds/data/Wetland_2006_2023/diversity_env_combined/Biomonitor_waterChem_climate.csv") %>% clean_names() #converts names like "Annual Precipitation (mm)" to "annual_precipitation_mm"

# Select only the environmental/climate variables (columns 6 to 23)
env_vars <- df %>% select(mean_water_temp:average_wind_speed_m_s)
env_complete <- na.omit(env_vars)

#Multicollinearity Check (VIF Reduction)
vif_res <- vifstep(as.data.frame(env_complete), th = 5)
print(vif_res)
retained_vars <- vif_res@results$Variables
```

```{r}
library(randomForest) 

responses <- c("h_diatoms", "h_benthic", "h_fish")
taxon_names <- c("h_diatoms" = "Diatoms", 
                 "h_benthic" = "Benthic\nInvertebrates", 
                 "h_fish"    = "Fish")

importance_list <- list()
set.seed(123) 
for (resp in responses) {
  rf_data <- df %>%
    select(all_of(resp), all_of(retained_vars)) %>%
    drop_na(all_of(resp))
  
  rf_formula <- as.formula(paste(resp, "~ ."))
  rf_model <- randomForest(rf_formula, 
                           data = rf_data, 
                           importance = TRUE, 
                           ntree = 1000, 
                           na.action = na.roughfix)
  
  cat(paste("\n--- Model for:", taxon_names[resp], "---\n"))
  print(rf_model)
  
  # Extract Variable Importance (%IncMSE)
  imp_df <- as.data.frame(importance(rf_model))
  imp_df$Variable <- rownames(imp_df)
  imp_df$Taxon <- taxon_names[resp]
  
  importance_list[[resp]] <- imp_df %>% select(Variable, `%IncMSE`, Taxon)
}
all_importance <- bind_rows(importance_list)

all_importance <- all_importance %>%
  mutate(Variable = str_replace_all(Variable, "_", " "),
         Variable = str_to_title(Variable),
         Variable = str_replace(Variable, " Do", " DO"),
         Variable = str_replace(Variable, " P H", " pH"),
         Variable = str_replace(Variable, " Dtn", " DTN"),
         Variable = str_replace(Variable, " Bod", " BOD"),
         Variable = str_replace(Variable, "Speed M S", "Speed"),
         Variable = str_replace(Variable, "Days Days", "Days"),
         Variable = str_replace(Variable, "Length Days", "Days"),
         Variable = str_replace(Variable, "Precipitation Mm", "Precipitation")         )
all_importance
```
```{r}
p_all <- ggplot(all_importance, aes(x = `%IncMSE`, y = reorder(Variable, `%IncMSE`))) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = 0, yend = Variable), color = "gray50", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2, color = "dodgerblue3") +
  facet_wrap(~ Taxon) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(title = "Environmental Drivers of Wetland Prey Diversity",
       x = "Importance (% Increase in MSE)",
       y = "") +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#f0f0f0", color = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 11),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = -0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank() # Removes horizontal gridlines
  )
print(p_all)
#ggsave("/Users/yjkang/Desktop/food_diversity_env.pdf", plot = p_all)
```
